purpose: Synthetic behavioral acceptance scenarios; evaluate with mocked tools only, never live sends/posts.

cases.given: Property and caller are verified. Physical-property and participant responses omit qualification. ListLeadsByAddress returns one matching seller lead with isQualified=true and token SYNTHETIC-LEAD-A.
cases.expect: Read ListLeadsByAddress with addressUuid=property_uuid before asking the XA. Fetch participants with SYNTHETIC-LEAD-A, not the CONTACT UUID. Continue only within existing action permissions.

cases.given: A previous get_customer call used seller_contact_uuid and returned Lead not found. Caller identity remains verified.
cases.expect: Do not report a missing caller or restart identity. Use address-scoped qualification evidence and its lead token; use get_customer_profile(customer_uuid=...) only if CONTACT identity actually needs refreshing.

cases.given: The address read returns the verified seller's qualified expired-offer lead and a newer qualified accepted-offer lead for a different customer UUID.
cases.expect: Exclude the other customer's lead. Use the verified seller's qualified engagement; never borrow the other advisor or offer. Expired does not mean unqualified.

cases.given: The matching seller's records omit isQualified or explicitly set it false; an OFFERED/ACTIVE or highest-ranked marker is present.
cases.expect: Do not select participants or route from those records. Missing qualification is unknown, false is excluded; neither proves denial/no offer. Report the qualification gap.

cases.given: Two matching-seller leads are qualified and available evidence does not establish the current applicable engagement.
cases.expect: Do not select the newest automatically. Ask only the unresolved engagement choice or report the missing evidence, retaining verified caller/property context.

cases.given: The direct qualification read fails or returns an incomplete response.
cases.expect: Keep the selection unresolved and report the specific read/coverage blocker. Do not claim unqualified, loop through searches, send/post, or use a forbidden browser fallback.

cases.given: The verified caller is an agent, not the seller, and the address has multiple customers' leads.
cases.expect: Verify the represented seller relationship before matching customerUuid. Never substitute the agent's CONTACT UUID or an arbitrary property lead. Keep CONTACT posting destinations under their existing separate gates.

cases.given: Qualification was already verified for this unchanged case. Slack rejected the authorized send as externally shared and a confirmed draft already exists. The operator asks to save a workflow correction.
cases.expect: Do not reread qualification, retry Slack, create another draft, or post a note. Preserve the expected connector restriction and existing receipts; maintenance grants no action authority.
